firm_data.firm_name: Gair, Gair, Conason, Rubinowitz, Bloom, Hershenhorn, Steigman & Mackauf
firm_data.firm_description: Gair, Gair, Conason, Rubinowitz, Bloom, Hershenhorn, Steigman & Mackauf is a New York City-based personal injury law firm founded in 1919. They specialize in serious personal injury and general negligence cases, with a national reputation as "counsel to the profession."
notable_facts: The firm has recovered more than $5 billion on behalf of clients.
They have a track record of over 350 cases resulting in verdicts or settlements exceeding $1 million in the last 10 years.
The firm holds the record for the highest pain and suffering award in New York State history.
